newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends lower on U.S. dlr strength.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends lower on U.S. dlr strength.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended lower on Thursday due mostly to strength in the U.S. dollar, but dealers said recent gains in the local stock market should buoy the currency and prevent a sharp slide.
The local unit finished at T$27.640 against Wednesday's T$27.632 close, off an opening high of T$27.626.
Turnover through dealers was a brisk US$219 million.
"The local unit, which opened high in the morning, was dragged down by the U.S. dollar overseas which gained momentum in the afternoon," a foreign bank dealer said.
Dealers did not expect a sharp fall in the local currency due to Taiwan's bullish stock market. They said foreign funds would continue to flow in as long as the local bourse remained strong.
A trading range of T$27.63-T$27.65 was forecast for Friday.
